properties.disease overview: Chronic elevation of systemic arterial blood pressure. Often primary (essential) with multifactorial causes; can also be secondary to identifiable conditions (renal/endocrine, etc.). Major long-term risks include stroke, MI, heart failure, CKD, retinopathy. / 系统动脉血压持续升高。多数为原发性（本态性）且多因素相关；也可为继发性（如肾源性/内分泌等）。长期可致卒中、心梗、心衰、慢性肾病、视网膜病变等。
properties.mechanism: BP = CO × TPR. Contributors include increased sympathetic tone, RAAS activation (Na⁺/water retention + vasoconstriction), impaired natriuresis (water follows sodium → ↑ECF volume), endothelial dysfunction and vascular remodeling → ↑TPR. Baroreflex resets in chronic HTN (poor long-term correction). / 血压=心输出量×外周阻力。机制包括交感兴奋、RAAS激活（保钠保水+血管收缩）、排钠能力下降（“水随钠走”→细胞外液容量↑）、内皮功能障碍与血管重构→TPR↑。慢性高血压下压力感受器反射重设，难以长期纠正。
